notes: SR Studios Worms FREE worm: a 6-joint chain from the tail (Worm_Rig_Main) to the head (Worm_Rig5). The pack has one take (Worm_Look), kept as the native Idle. Walk, Run, Attack and Death are the janpec Animal pack deluxe Viper Glide, FastGlide, Attack and Die, retargeted by arc length: each worm segment takes the world rotation of the viper spine bone at the same share of body length from the tail tip (Back_01_07, Back_01_04, Front_01_01, Front_01_05, Front_01_10, Head_Top), and the tail joint translates with the viper tail tip (hipMode root) at worm-to-viper length 0.135, so the body curve is the viper's. The strike is the viper's: only its front fifth rears, so it reads small. Hissing barely moves the body, so Hit is omitted (runtime flinch on the front half, hitRecoil from Worm_Rig3). The Quaternius snake was tried and rejected: its Attack buries the body in the floor.
